title: Host registry (laptop, internal)
description: %USERPROFILE%\.agentspace\hosts.json (D45, D55, D67): the host registry, one record per host, saying which host serves which project, and from v0.09 the instance type its stack was last deployed with. Internal: it is laptop state, never output, and no lease command prints anything from it. A missing file reads as one record, the box's: project swimcoach, stack agentbox, state ready, and from v0.09 instance_type m9g.xlarge. Strict like the contract's output schemas: anchored patterns end with $(?!\n). A file in which two records share a project is not valid, though this schema cannot refuse it; docs/state.md says how a reader treats one. A file is valid only with exactly one record whose stack is agentbox, and its project is swimcoach (docs/state.md, "The host registry"), which no schema can check. See docs/state.md, "The host registry".

version.description: The format's version. 0 until a change that an older reader would misread.

project.description: The normalized project the host serves, in the lease contract's form.

stack.description: The host's CloudFormation stack: agentbox, the box's, or agentspace-host-<project>. This schema cannot check that <project> is the record's own project.

state.description: creating while a provisioning run is under way or has died, ready once the host is made and set up, failed when a run's step failed.

instance_id.description: The host's instance ID, cached from its stack's InstanceId output. Absent until it is known.

instance_type.description: The instance type of the host's stack, its InstanceType parameter as describe-stacks read it back after the last deploy that recorded it (D67, D71). The form of the operator's -InstanceType value, at most 64 characters. Absent until a deploy of v0.09 or later has recorded it, and while a deploy that changes it is under way; a record without it meets no size. Written after instance_id and before last_attempt_at. See docs/state.md, "The instance type".

last_attempt_at.description: The start time of the last provisioning run, UTC. Absent while no run has been started.
